g.text: Three-seed paired evaluation under author semantics
Lower panels: GAS-MARL vs PPO within seed. Seed points average 10 fixed windows × 1024 jobs.
SD is descriptive across 3 end-to-end seeds; training seed equals base evaluation seed.
11 window pairs overlap; no CI, significance test, or claim of exact numerical reproduction.
